status: candidate calibration: the scales and zeros are the radar firmware decode (8S302-3A0-A230 and -A070 read range as 0.05*raw m, lateral as 0.01*raw - 81.91 m and velocity as 0.1*raw - 154.0 m/s; bosch-c-research docs/radar-firmware-a230.md). The x_reference_offset is still a candidate: our measured offset to the bumper reference, since the firmware reads range with no offset.
development_data: 0000016d segment 10; fixed matched wire ID19/HUD ID2; the range offset is a median alignment to nominal HUD positions. Velocity zero was 1539 from stationary persistent tracks in segment 0 until 2026-10-02, when it moved to the firmware zero 1540.
physical_scale_evidence: 5 cm/count distance, 0.1 m/s/count velocity and 0.01 m/count lateral match the radar firmware's own getters (2026-10-02), as did the earlier accepted working conversions. Lateral was 1/128 m/count until 2026-09-28.
range_field: Range is 48:12 (accepted 2026-09-28 on held-out routes); bits 60-63 are the object class. dRel = 0.05*raw12 - 4.296 m. Before 2026-09-28 range was read as 48:13 with x_zero 4096, identical for status-1 objects.
